overview: Two related quantities describing how fast something moves — only one of them cares which way it's going.
genZNote: Speed tells you how fast. Velocity tells you how fast and which way.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Rate of change of distance with time.
aspects.valueB: Rate of change of displacement with time.

aspects.label: Can Be Negative?
aspects.valueB: Yes, depending on the chosen positive direction.

aspects.label: Round Trip Example
aspects.valueA: Nonzero average speed for any completed motion.
aspects.valueB: Zero average velocity if net displacement is zero.
